text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's weird... I thought I was working on 
my abs...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, singing with a weak vibrato like 
this won't cheer anyone up~!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um... my voice doesn't seem to be carrying 
well. It's like I can't put any power into 
my body.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...No, no! Don't lose heart! One more 
time, shout from the bottom of your gut—!

It seems fatigue is catching up to her. 
Perhaps I should reconsider her racing 
schedule.
